_comment: Core-preamble token budgets (chars/4 heuristic) per MILE-30. Measures ONLY the section before CORE_PREAMBLE_MARKER -- @-included reference content is excluded by design. Coordinator gets the largest budget since it owns orchestration/return-contract complexity that can't be fully delegated to references without losing hard-rule visibility; planner is next given its goal-backward derivation logic; verifier/debugger/executor get progressively smaller budgets proportionate to their current sizes, since they have narrower single-purpose roles.
